section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed; absent/failed budget artifacts are a blocking gate failure.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Audited artifact is a Phase 8 deliverable (schema_id "orch.tier5.review_packet.v1", a review packet). The on-disk budget gate record docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json has "gate_pass_declaration": "fail" (run_id 584ecd9f-81c8-4caf-a8d8-c7c95f6a28b3), with blocking inconsistency BLK-01 ("absent budget artifacts constitute a blocking gate failure, not a hold state"). Per check 13.4, a Phase 8 artifact exists while the budget_gate_assessment declares 'fail'. The Phase 8 review packet also references effort figures as content (e.g. F-8 evidence: "MATE 2.4 PM, MVCRI 1.5 PM, AgroVIR 3.0 PM, supervisor 2.5 PM, co-supervisor 2.0 PM ... The fellow's own 30.0 PM allocation is firm"). Note for the human operator (surfaced, not resolved per §12.3/Constraint 2): the assessment records the lump-sum Mode B channel and itself states the instrument resolves to MSCA-PF (unit_cost regime), whose sanctioned source is the deterministic derivation unit_cost_budget.json rather than this lump-sum channel; there is also a run_id mismatch between the review packet (845413cf) and the recorded gate assessment (584ecd9f). Resolution requires the human operator to confirm that gate_09 passed for the unit-cost source before this Phase 8 review packet may advance.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions when inputs are incomplete.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific inputs in Tier 1–4.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entries.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. A Phase 8 deliverable (review packet) is present while docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json records gate_pass_declaration='fail' (blocking inconsistency BLK-01). This skill does not resolve the violation: the operator must confirm whether gate_09 passed via the sanctioned unit-cost deterministic derivation (unit_cost_budget.json) for the MSCA-PF instrument, and reconcile the run_id mismatch (review packet run 845413cf vs gate assessment run 584ecd9f), before this Phase 8 artifact may advance. Per CLAUDE.md §13.4/§8.4 the categorical Phase-8 block is unconditional until gate_09 confirms a complete, structurally consistent budget.
